notes: One game played on a board (a match). Not the app itself. ru/pl: партия/partia as in chess apps, because игра/gra is also the app.
Another player (human or bot) in the same game.

th: ชัยชนะ / ชนะ
notes: Result of a game: the 'Victory!' headline, 'Win' on history cards, counted 'wins'. After ' / ': the short result label where it differs from the noun.

th: ความพ่ายแพ้ / แพ้
notes: Result of a game: 'Defeat' headline, 'Loss' on history cards. After ' / ': the short result label where it differs from the noun.
Final result when the scores are equal ('Draw' on results; the English app says 'Tie' on history cards). Not the in-game 'tied' state.
The Elo-style number that ranked games move up or down. Never the score of one game (that is points).
A private room where 2-4 friends start a game, with a 6-digit code ('Room with friends', 'Room code').

th: คำเชิญ / เชิญ
notes: noun / verb. An invitation to a friends room; 'Invite friends' (Hebrew verb as on that button: הזמן חברים).
One of the 81 squares of the board. Its name (D5: row letter A-I + column digit 1-9) is never translated.
Horizontal line of 9 cells, lettered A-I from the top. zh-Hant: 橫列, because in Taiwan 列 is a row and 行 a column (the opposite of mainland usage).
Vertical line of 9 cells, numbered 1-9 from the left. zh-Hant: 直行 (see row).
One of the nine 3×3 squares, numbered 1-9. Not the moderation block (see block).

th: ตัวเลขโจทย์
notes: In this app רמז means a GIVEN: a digit printed on the board from the start (01-SPEC §2). There is no hint button (D59). Use the sudoku word for givens/clues; 'No hints' = boards with very few givens.

th: ข้อผิดพลาด
notes: A wrong digit entered in a cell. It costs points.
noun / verb. Reporting a player to moderation ('Report player', 'Send report').

ja: ブロック / ブロックする
notes: noun / verb. Blocking a player (moderation). Never the 3×3 box and never the cell lock.
A 5-second effect a player buys with points and launches at an opponent's screen (fireworks, cats, ink...). Playful, not technical.

th: ล็อก / ถูกล็อก
notes: noun / adjective. The cell a player picks is locked to that player for the thinking time; nobody else can touch it. Also 'Locks' in stats.
Games that count for rating ('Ranked', 'ranked games'). Make it agree with your word for game.
Unranked play: solo, vs bot, and 'Staged practice' (אימון בשלבים).
One short challenge of Staged practice (L001-L300, 0-3 stars). NEVER your word for 'level': level is the bot level and the XP level.
The 10th stage of each chapter: a race or duel against a named bot.
Rating tier: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Diamond, Legend ('{{league}} league').
Experience points. Keep XP in Latin letters in every language: the result screen draws it in Teko, which has only Latin letters (D107).
Watching a finished game again, move by move, with explanations. NEVER 'play again' (es volver a jugar, fr rejouer, de nochmal spielen).

th: ชี้ตำแหน่ง
notes: A stage kind (English 'Pinpoint'): a digit is shown and you tap the one cell where it goes, no keypad. Short; works as a name.
A short emoji sent during a game. Not a reply or comment (Hebrew תגובה also means reply).

th: คะแนนเท่ากัน
notes: During a game: equal scores right now ('Lead: Tie'). Not the final result (see draw).
The puzzle. The brand Sudoku Fight is never translated or transliterated.
The 9×9 grid. Always shown left to right, with Western digits.
A digit 1-9 placed in a cell. Always Western digits.
full / short unit ('pts'). What a move earns or an interference costs. Not rating.
0-3 stars per stage.
Bot level (1-5) and XP level. Not stage.
10 consecutive stages on the map; 30 chapters, each ending in a boss.
